meta.title: PromptBox — free your mind, your own AI prompt vault
meta.description: PromptBox is a local-first prompt manager built for the AI era. SQLCipher encryption, variable templates, card chaining, MCP integration for your IDE — core features free forever.

hero.titleLead: The password manager for the AI era —
hero.titleAccent: but for your prompts, settings and keys
hero.lead: Your context lives on your own machine; any AI can use it, no vendor can take it.
hero.imageAlt: The PromptBox main window: folders and tags on the left, prompt cards on the right

item1.title: Two layers of encryption
item1.body: The whole database is encrypted at rest with SQLCipher; secret cards get a second layer of AES-256-GCM on top. Keys are held by the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain).

item2.title: Released only with your consent
item2.body: Only the content you copy or explicitly release ever reaches ChatGPT or Claude.

item3.title: You decide when to update
item3.body: The app never checks for updates and never installs one silently. We announce new versions by email; when to download and install over the old one is entirely your call.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Are my prompts uploaded to the cloud?
faq.a1: Never. Since v3.3.1 PromptBox is 100% offline (zero outbound). Every update check and telemetry hook has been removed from the app, and fonts ship with the binary instead of loading from a CDN. All data is encrypted at rest with SQLCipher (AES-256) on your own disk, with the key held by your operating system's secure keychain (Keychain / DPAPI). No third party can reach it. The one networked component is the built-in MCP server: it listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so the IDEs on your own machine can connect to it, and it never reaches outward.
faq.q2: Are secret cards safe? Can the AI read them?
faq.a2: Secret cards use per-card scrypt + AES-256-GCM encryption and need your own password to unlock in the GUI. From v3.6.0 on, password protection and visibility to AI are two independent axes: when a card is visible to AI, the AI sees only its name, description and ID; the content is released only after you hit allow in the consent dialog and type your password — every single time. You can tick “don’t ask again for 10 minutes”, which stops repeat prompts for that card in that window (held in memory only, never the password, and dropped instantly on lock screen or manual revocation). The boundary worth stating plainly: card names, descriptions and variable names are not protected by the password, and variable default values are stored as plaintext independently of it — so avoid putting hints about a secret into those names.
faq.q3: Is installing safe? Could I lose data?
faq.a3: Installers are published directly from this site, each with a SHA-256 checksum so you can verify the file’s integrity. We have not bought a code signing certificate yet, so Windows may show an “unrecognised app” prompt — the download page and the manual explain why and how to check for yourself. The encrypted database is created on first launch, and when you upgrade, the old plaintext database is automatically backed up as promptbox.db.plain.bak. The app never performs a silent background upgrade: new versions are announced by email and installed manually over the old one. The install path doesn’t change and your data stays exactly where it is.
faq.a4: Windows 10 / 11 today (64-bit, with both an installer and a portable build). The macOS build is still in preparation and has not been released — leave your email on the download page and we will tell you the day it ships. The built-in MCP server connects locally to Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Claude Code, Cline and other mainstream AI tools.
faq.q5: Is it really free? What are the limits?
faq.a5: The core workflow is free forever: prompt management, folders, tags, global search, one-click copy, Markdown preview and light/dark themes all cost nothing. (Free tier quotas: {cards} cards in total — secret and chained cards count towards that same number, of which up to {secretCards} may be secret and up to {chainCards} may sit in a chain folder — plus {mcpTokens} MCP tokens. Quotas only block new items; nothing you already have is ever removed.) Advanced features use a buy-once-plus-update-rights model: Personal Pro at the early-bird price of ${proEarly} USD / year (locked for life, including the current version forever plus {updateMonths} months of updates; if you stop renewing you keep the current version forever), lifetime updates for ${lifetime} USD one-time, or a commercial licence at ${commercial} USD / seat / year.
